# Loading Libraries and Data

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(caret)
library(class)
library(e1071)

# Load the SKCM data
load("SKCM.rda")
```

# Prepare data

```{r}
# Extract batch information from TCGA barcodes
ids <- as.character(colData(query2)$barcode)
batch <- sapply(strsplit(ids, "-"), function(x) { 
  if (length(x) >= 6) 
    return(x[6]) 
  else 
    return(NA)
})
batch_id <- as.factor(batch)

# Extract clinical and create survival
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(patient, gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
               ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = days_to_death / 365,
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_years = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  )

# Add batch information to clinical data
clinical$batch_id <- batch_id
rownames(clinical) <- ids

# Get FPKM-UQ expression data and log2 transform
fpkm <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")
log_expr <- log2(fpkm + 1)

# Filter low-expressed genes
gene_means <- rowMeans(log_expr)
expressed_genes <- which(gene_means > 1)  # Keep genes with average log2(FPKM+1) > 1
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr[expressed_genes, ]
```

# Batch Correction

```{r}
# Get complete samples
complete_samples <- !is.na(batch_id) & 
                    !is.na(clinical$survival_time) & 
                    !is.na(clinical$gender)

# Filter expression data
log_expr_filtered_clean <- log_expr_filtered[, complete_samples]
batch_id_clean <- batch_id[complete_samples]
clinical_clean <- clinical[complete_samples, ]

# survival groups based on quartiles
surv_quartiles <- quantile(clinical_clean$survival_time, 
                          probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), 
                          na.rm = TRUE)

clinical_clean$survival_group <- cut(clinical_clean$survival_time, 
                                    breaks = surv_quartiles, 
                                    include.lowest = TRUE, 
                                    labels = c("Q1 (Low)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (High)"))

# design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~0 + survival_group + gender, data = clinical_clean)
colnames(design) <- c("Q1_Low", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4_High", "gender")

# Apply batch correction using removeBatchEffect
combat_expr <- removeBatchEffect(log_expr_filtered_clean, 
                               batch = batch_id_clean,
                               design = design)

cat("Expression data dimensions after batch correction:", dim(combat_expr), "\n")
```

# Prepare data

```{r}
# Select top variable genes
gene_vars <- apply(combat_expr, 1, var)
top_var_genes <- order(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:2000]
expr_top_var <- combat_expr[top_var_genes, ]

# PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(t(expr_top_var), scale = TRUE)
var_explained <- (pca_result$sdev^2) / sum(pca_result$sdev^2) * 100

# keep 80% of variance PCs
cum_var <- cumsum(var_explained)
n_pcs <- which(cum_var >= 80)[1]
cat("Number of PCs explaining 80% of variance:", n_pcs, "\n")

# Create df with PCs and survival group
pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:n_pcs])
pca_data$survival_group <- clinical_clean$survival_group

# Remove rows with NAs
pca_data_complete <- pca_data[complete.cases(pca_data), ]
```

# Implement 4NN Classification

```{r}
# Split data
set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(pca_data_complete$survival_group, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- pca_data_complete[train_index, ]
test_data <- pca_data_complete[-train_index, ]

# Extract features and labels
train_features <- train_data[, 1:(ncol(train_data)-1)]
train_labels <- train_data$survival_group
test_features <- test_data[, 1:(ncol(test_data)-1)]
test_labels <- test_data$survival_group

# 4NN classification
knn_pred <- knn(
  train = train_features,
  test = test_features,
  cl = train_labels,
  k = 4
)

# Calculate confusion matrix and performance metrics
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(knn_pred, test_labels)
print(conf_matrix)
```

# Visualization & Evaluation

```{r}
# Plot confusion matrix
conf_data <- as.data.frame(conf_matrix$table)
names(conf_data) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Frequency")

ggplot(conf_data, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Frequency)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Frequency), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "4NN Confusion Matrix", 
       x = "Predicted Class", 
       y = "Actual Class")

# PCAs
test_results <- test_data
test_results$predicted <- knn_pred

# Plot by actual class
p1 <- ggplot(test_results, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = survival_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot - Actual Survival Groups",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
       color = "Survival Group")

# Plot by predicted class
p2 <- ggplot(test_results, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = predicted)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot - Predicted Survival Groups",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
       color = "Predicted Group")

# Print plots
print(p1)
print(p2)
```
